title: Create Semio React Bundle With Rust Worker Store
description: Create `semio/react` bundle that exports React hooks backed by a long-lived Rust worker as store. Extend `semio/rs` with async tokio events for granular kit changes. Hooks use KitProvider with backbone support (local/dev/remote) and PieceProvider for scoped piece data access. Hooks: usePieceName, usePieceDescription, usePieceTypeId, usePieceDesignId, usePieceBlueprintId, usePiecePlane, usePieceCenter, usePieceFlatPlane, usePieceFlatCenter, useParentPieceId, useParentConnectionId, useChildPiecesIds, useChildConnectionsIds, useAlternativeTypeIds.
summary: Separated the React hook layer into semio/react with its own package, tsconfig, and Vitest config; repaired semio/js after removing the embedded React suite; restored the js embedded test wrapper and missing asset fixture import; updated root Vitest projects; fixed stale MCP Apps package references in semio/ui; validated semio/react editor diagnostics and its embedded test suite (4/4 passing). semio/js embedded tests now execute again but still do not complete cleanly within the current run window and were left with additional failing assertions outside the React extraction repair.
